using JSON3
result = Dict{String,Any}("hostname" => gethostname())
println(stderr, "NODE: ", gethostname()); flush(stderr)
d = mktempdir(); f = joinpath(d, "diag.sh")
write(f, raw"""
set +e
source /scratch/coop/drozda/jax-env/bin/activate
SP=$(python -c "import site;print(site.getsitepackages()[0])")
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$(ls -d $SP/nvidia/*/lib | tr '\n' ':')"
export XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false
cat > t_conv.py << 'EOF'
import sys, numpy as np, jax, jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import lax
mode, dt = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
if dt == "f64": jax.config.update("jax_enable_x64", True)
T = jnp.float64 if dt == "f64" else jnp.float32
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
x = jnp.asarray(rng.standard_normal((1, 8, 32, 32)), dtype=T); w = jnp.asarray(rng.standard_normal((8, 8, 3, 3)), dtype=T)
dn = ("NCHW", "OIHW", "NCHW")
if mode == "patches":
    def conv(x, w):
        p = lax.conv_general_dilated_patches(x, (3, 3), (1, 1), "SAME", dimension_numbers=dn)   # (1, 8*9, H, W)
        return jnp.einsum("bkhw,ok->bohw", p, w.reshape(w.shape[0], -1))
else:
    conv = lambda x, w: lax.conv_general_dilated(x, w, (1, 1), "SAME", dimension_numbers=dn)
f = jax.jit(conv); y = f(x, w).block_until_ready()
res = {"fwd_ok": True, "dtype": str(y.dtype), "sum": float(y.sum())}
if mode != "fwd":
    g = jax.jit(jax.grad(lambda w_: jnp.sum(conv(x, w_) ** 2)))(w).block_until_ready()
    res["grad_ok"] = True
print("RESULT", res)
EOF
run() { echo "== $1"; shift; "$@" 2>&1 | grep -E "RESULT|cudnn|CUDNN|Error|error" | head -${LINES_MAX:-4} | cut -c1-330; }
run "f32 fwd+grad (cuDNN)"            python t_conv.py fwdgrad f32
run "f32 fwd"                         python t_conv.py fwd f32
run "f64 fwd (cuDNN)"                 python t_conv.py fwd f64
run "f64 fwd, autotune_level=0"       env XLA_FLAGS=--xla_gpu_autotune_level=0 python t_conv.py fwd f64
LINES_MAX=14 run "f64 fwd, cuDNN API log" env CUDNN_LOGERR_DBG=1 CUDNN_LOGDEST_DBG=stderr python t_conv.py fwd f64
run "f64 fwd+grad via im2col patches" python t_conv.py patches f64
run "f64 patches fwd only"            python t_conv.py patches f64
echo "== cudnn / nvrtc lib files"; ls $SP/nvidia/cudnn/lib | head -20; ls $SP/nvidia/cuda_nvrtc/lib
""")
try
    out = IOBuffer(); err = IOBuffer()
    p = run(pipeline(ignorestatus(Cmd(`bash $f`; dir=d)), stdout=out, stderr=err))
    result["exit"] = p.exitcode
    result["diag"] = String(take!(out))
    result["stderr_tail"] = let s = String(take!(err)); s[max(1,end-600):end] end
catch e
    result["error"] = sprint(showerror, e)
end
println(JSON3.write(result))
